verdict.rationale: Claude Code install is two slash commands: add the marketplace, then install the plugin. Devin CLI is a single `devin plugins install obra/superpowers`. Skills then auto-trigger at session start with no further setup, so going from nothing to a working skill looks quick. However, installation differs by harness, and community feedback calls the Codex/OpenCode install mechanism unusual. missing for 10: an explicit timed quickstart guide, hands-on or independent confirmation of the under-five-minute experience, and uniformly simple install steps across all harnesses (e.g. Hermes requires a git clone).
